finish_summary:
bulk_discount_percent(50) returns 5 but spec expects 10.
parse_coupon is case-sensitive and does not strip whitespace; spec requires case-insensitivity and trimming.
Subtotal calculation: implementation ignores bulk discounts or misapplies them; spec expects discount applied per item.
remove_item leaves quantity zero in items(); spec says remove completely when zero.
total calculation: shipping fee not added on empty cart; spec says no shipping for empty. Implementation gives 0.
